sources.description: Acquired (7.1MB nationwide Shapefile, zip, EUC-encoded DBF read as cp932). Filtered to 釧網線 (Senmo Line) features within ~2.5km of the World origin: 1 station point (緑, 144.50575/43.71802) and 3 RailroadSection line segments (2, 112, 254 vertices respectively before clipping). Original datalist page (KsjTmplt-N02.html) 404'd — the live URL structure has a per-year suffix (KsjTmplt-N02-2025.html); the archive of editions was found by following that page's own links back to 2005-2025 (with a 2009-2010, 2019 gap — no vintage exists for exactly 2010).

sources.description: Acquired (7.2MB nationwide Shapefile, zip). Same 緑 station point and same 3 釧網線 line segments as SRC_MLIT_KSJ_N02_2008 — every coordinate byte-identical between the two editions (max per-vertex difference: 0.0 degrees, checked programmatically). Used with the 2008 edition to bracket the World's 2010-05-30 target date: since MLIT's official railway dataset agrees exactly on both sides of that date, this Reality Data is treated as confidence A / historical_status confirmed for the station point and the 3 clipped line segments, per Directive 02 §25 (temporal relevance + source authority + internal consistency).

sources.license: 国土数値情報 利用約款
sources.description: Acquired (2.7MB zip for 1st-order mesh 6544, which covers this World). 102 road LineString features fall within 2.5km of the World origin (1,930 vertices total). This is the ONLY N13 vintage available near our target date — the live site's edition list jumps directly from 2024 to 2026, with no historical archive back to 2010 (unlike N02, which has yearly-ish editions back to 2005). Per Directive 02 §14/§25, current-condition-only data cannot itself confirm 2010 existence — recorded at confidence B / historical_status 'current-only', existence_in_2010: unknown, per-feature.

sources.dataset_name: 標高タイル DEM10B (基盤地図情報数値標高モデルを線形平滑化), z=14, text format
sources.data_date: unknown — GSI's own page states the tile SERVICE began 2013-10-30, but does not give a per-region underlying survey date on the page fetched; not independently confirmed for this specific mesh
sources.license: 国土地理院コンテンツ利用規約
sources.description: Acquired: 9 tiles (3x3) at zoom 14 around the station, no NODATA cells, stitched into a 768x768 grid then cropped+downsampled (stride 3, ~30m spacing) to a 240x240 grid covering ~2.5km of the World origin for reality/dem.json. DEM5A/5B/5C and DEM1A (finer, ~1-5m mesh) all returned 404 for this rural tile — no high-resolution LiDAR coverage exists here; DEM10B (10m, nationwide baseline) is the finest tier actually available at this location. Elevation range in the cropped area: 99.5m-298.3m, which is far more topographically varied than Directive 01's flat ~130m synthetic guess. Recorded as confidence B (real government elevation data) / historical_status 'plausible' (terrain changes slowly enough that an undated-but-recent DEM is a reasonable, though not certified, stand-in for 2010 terrain) rather than A, since the exact survey date for this specific area was not confirmed.

sources.dataset_name: 写真（全国最新写真（シームレス）; seamlessphoto tile layer), z=18
sources.data_date: unknown, mixed per-tile — GSI's own documentation says this composite is assembled from multiple sources (電子国土基本図オルソ画像 / 東日本大震災後正射画像 / 森林の空中写真 / 地方公共団体等の空中写真 / 簡易空中写真) with no single capture date
sources.publication_date: 2016-12-21 (layer service start, per GSI ichiran page)
sources.license: 国土地理院コンテンツ利用規約
sources.description: Acquired and visually inspected: a 2x2 tile mosaic (z18) centered on the station was fetched and viewed at native resolution with a pixel-coordinate grid overlay. Confirms real railway trackage, a paralleling road, and residential structures near the station — but the same imagery also shows large ground-mounted solar panel arrays, which are definitively a post-2012 feature in Japan (FIT-scheme solar farms of this scale did not exist in 2010). This proves the composite includes recent (well past 2010) source photography, so it CANNOT be used as 2010-dated evidence for anything — it was used only to visually sanity-check the World's general layout and to cross-check the direction of the MLIT KSJ N02 railway geometry (which matched). Superseded as the railway source by SRC_MLIT_KSJ_N02_2008/2011 (properly dated, bracketing 2010).

sources.description: STILL NOT acquired even after Full network access was enabled. Directive 04 probed this specific URL 4 times across two rounds (before and after the policy change): 403, then 502 x2 on repeat. Also could not determine, per the user's explicit ask, whether this UI-driven service exposes a documented lat/lon+year query endpoint — GSI's own tile-service documentation (ichiran.html, which WAS reachable) does not mention one for mapps.gsi.go.jp; the actual working alternative GSI provides is the directly-queryable XYZ tile endpoints (seamlessphoto, nendophoto{year}, ort, airphoto — see SRC_GSI_SEAMLESSPHOTO), which were used instead and did not require this blocked host at all.

sources.dataset_name: 観光情報「緑の湯」ページ
sources.data_date: page last updated 2026-06-23; content describes a facility that opened 平成11年 (1999)
sources.description: Acquired (fetched via raw curl — WebFetch itself returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for this domain even though the underlying proxy allowed it, an inconsistency worth noting). Address: 清里町緑町26番地. Access described as 'JR緑駅または「みどり」バス停徒歩3分' (3 min walk from Midori Station). Page states the facility 'opened in 平成11年 (1999)' at the station front (緑駅前). Also mentions a 緑駅前広場パークゴルフ場 (park-golf course) at the station plaza. Priority 1 municipal source. Used as evidence for existence-by-2010 (opened 1999, well before the target date) and as a real address for the facility, though no coordinate is published — see reconstruction.json for how this was turned into a (deliberately imprecise) Reality Data point.

sources.dataset_name: 清里町の歴史（まちの情報）
sources.data_date: town timeline, entries from Meiji era through present
sources.description: Acquired (raw curl). Official town history timeline states: '平成元年 第1回みどりのフェスティバル開催' — the first みどりのフェスティバル was held in 1989 (Heisei 1), listed as one of the town's notable historical milestones. This independently corroborates that みどりのフェスティバル is a real, long-running recurring town event (21 years old by 2010), which is genuine Priority 1 evidence for the event's general existence and institutional continuity — though it does NOT independently confirm the specific 2010-05-30 date or that year's exact program (クマゲラ太鼓/丸太転がし選手権/みどりのウォーキング), which still trace only to the operator's own assertion (SRC_USER_DIRECTIVE_02).

Two are load-bearing for this pass: way 131758648/131758654/131758660 tagged highway=secondary, ref=1115, name=mashuuko shari line (directly identifies the road's actual alignment), and way 131759316/131759747 tagged highway=tertiary, name=ekimae-doori, whose endpoint sits ~44m from LOC_MIDORI_STATION. Text confirms: event name ("みどりのフェスティバル", body also says "緑のフェスティバル"), date 2010-05-30, venue (清里町緑町の駅前広場), and three activities (クマゲラ太鼓, 丸太転がし選手権, みどりのウォーキング), with 3 photos. sources.dataset_name: 国鉄キハ54形気動車
sources.description: キハ54形500番台（北海道仕様車）の諸元と車体仕様。全長21,300mm／全幅2,920mm／全高3,620mm(501-)／自重38.7t。ステンレス製軽量車体、車体裾は絞りのない直線形状、側面窓上下にビード加工、客用扉は車体両端に片側2扉（850mm片開き引戸）、両運転台・低運転台、正面は平妻貫通式で運転台窓回りを黒色とした大窓風、運転台窓上に種別・行先表示器、前面と側面の接合部に白色FRPの額縁、客室窓は小型一段上昇式の二重窓、冷房なしで屋上に押し込み式通風器、水タンクは屋上、運転台下にスカート。塗装は赤16号を主体に下部へクリーム10号と灰茶8号の細線。
sources.note: 百科事典であり一次資料ではない。confidence は B が上限。車体形状・塗色の読み取りに用い、2010-05-30 当日の運用車両の直接証拠としては用いない。

sources.dataset_name: 釧網本線
sources.description: 路線データ：全線単線・非電化、軌間1,067mm、最急勾配25.0‰（緑—川湯温泉間）、最高速度 夏季80km/h・冬季75km/h、緑駅は起点から100.9km、隣駅は川湯温泉(86.4km)と札弦(109.2km)。運行：釧路—摩周間と緑—網走間の区間列車が存在し、「摩周&川湯温泉足湯めぐり号」の愛称は摩周(釧路)発が2010年の運行より、緑(網走)発が2011年7月1日より命名。掲載写真に「一部列車で運用されていたキハ40形（2009年5月 緑駅）」がある。
sources.note: 百科事典であり一次資料ではない。confidence は B が上限。

sources.dataset_name: 緑駅 写真41点・動画2本
sources.description: ユーザーが収集・提供した緑駅の静止画41点および動画2本（89秒・28秒）。うち1点はほぼ正射投影の正面立面写真で、本Worldの駅舎寸法・屋根形状の実測に用いた。他に待合室内部、ホーム、駅名標、時刻表、街路、航空写真（2004/2011/2012年）、ストリートビュー（2014年・2023年）を含む。
sources.note: 撮影年次不明のものが大半であり、2010-05-30 の直接証拠にはならない。形状の読み取りに用い、confidence は B が上限。一部にストックフォトのウォーターマークを含むものがあり、形状・色の参照にのみ用いて再配布はしない。個人が写り込んでいる画像は再現の対象としない。

sources.dataset_name: 軌間・レール・まくらぎ・道床の規格値
sources.description: 在来線の軌間1,067 mm、50kgNレール(高さ153 mm・頭部幅65 mm・底部幅127 mm)、木まくらぎ並型2,100×240×140 mm、乙線のまくらぎ配置39本/25 m、道床厚200 mm・肩幅400 mm・のり面1:1.5、地方交通線の低いホーム高さ レール面上760 mm。いずれも緑駅の実測ではなく全国共通の規格値であり、src/generators/TrackGeometry.ts に定数として一箇所にまとめてある。ホーム高さと車両の輪重位置はこのレール頭面高さから導出しており、独立に推定していない。
